column1: # Bundle license manifest — one row per shipped binary/dylib (or vendored-in
# static component). license-audit.sh asserts every Mach-O in the bundle maps

# bundle's LICENSES/. Only libraries the bundle really holds have a row: one
# that turns up without a row fails the audit, which is the point.
# artifact-pattern matches the basename inside the .app bundle.
